gaps.sentence: I can't wait ___ you the photos.
gaps.explanation: can't wait + to-infinitive: can't wait to show.

gaps.sentence: I can't afford ___ another month abroad.
They made me ___ for the whole team's mistake.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive in active sentences: made me apologise.

gaps.sentence: I'm sorry for ___ so long to reply.
On the way to Rome we stopped ___ some photos.
gaps.hint: stop in order to do sth
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do; stop doing = finish doing. Here they paused to take photos.

gaps.sentence: I was made ___ the dustbin lorry at six in the morning.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, make takes the to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: She insisted on ___ for the meal herself.
My boss won't ___ me take Friday off.
gaps.explanation: let + object + bare infinitive: won't let me take. (allow/permit take to: allow me to take.)
